metadata.title: GERMLINE Antibody Corpus v0.1 — reproducible security antibodies from fixed, publicly disclosed vulnerabilities
metadata.description:
The GERMLINE Antibody Corpus v0.1 contains 100 antibodies: executable, permanently reproducible security checks derived from fixed, publicly disclosed memory-safety vulnerabilities in 17 critical C/C++ projects (libxml2, ffmpeg, ImageMagick, harfbuzz, curl, wireshark, ghostpdl, php-src, libarchive, gpac, binutils-gdb, freetype2, openssl, libwebp, zlib, libpng, libtiff).

Each antibody encodes a discriminating experiment: one pinned environment that must fail (crash with a specified sanitizer marker) and one that must stay clean, plus the evidence that this discrimination has been measured. Records reference public OSS-Fuzz reports and upstream fix commits; no binaries, crash inputs, or exploit payloads are redistributed.

The corpus ships in two formats: human-friendly authoring manifests and the ABX v0.1 wire format (RFC-0), with a strict JSON Schema, a reference validator (convert / validate / digest), and an append-only verification log. At v0.1, 3 of 100 antibodies are verified end-to-end on hosted Docker runners (crash-on-vulnerable / clean-on-fixed, reproduced across independent runs); the remaining records are explicitly marked as draft.

Derived from ARVO — Atlas of Reproducible Vulnerabilities (EuroS&P 2026), which curates OSS-Fuzz reports. Data: CC-BY-4.0. Code: Apache-2.0.
metadata.notes: Pre-alpha research artifact. Verification policy and per-record status are documented in corpus/VERIFICATION.md and the datasheet. Contact via GitHub issues.
